mapper.select: select count(*) as review_count,round(avg(rating), 1) as average_rating from tbl_review where expert_seq = #{expertSeq}
select r.*,m.name as customer_name from tbl_review r inner join tbl_member m on m.member_seq = r.customer_seq where r.expert_Seq = #{expertSeq} order by r.regdate desc fetch first 5 rows only

select r.*, c.name as customer_name, e.name as expert_name from tbl_review r inner join tbl_member c on c.member_seq = r.customer_seq inner join tbl_member e on e.member_seq = r.expert_seq inner join tbl_expert_profile p on p.expert_seq = r.expert_seq where p.hidden = 'N' and e.enabled = 'Y' order by r.regdate desc fetch first 3 rows only
mapper.insert: insert into tbl_review (review_seq, trade_seq, customer_seq, expert_seq, rating, content) values (seq_review.nextval, #{tradeSeq}, #{customerSeq}, #{expertSeq}, #{rating}, #{content})
